title: delete_task
prompt: Write delete_task(tasks, index) returning (new_list, deleted_task). Out-of-range: ([], None) when tasks is empty, otherwise (copy unchanged, None).

tests.name: deletes and reports
tests.code:
tasks = [{"text": "a", "done": False}, {"text": "b", "done": False}]
new, gone = delete_task(tasks, 0)
assert gone == {"text": "a", "done": False} and new == [{"text": "b", "done": False}], f"got {new}, {gone}"
new2, gone2 = delete_task(tasks, 5)
assert gone2 is None and new2 == tasks, "out of range -> (unchanged, None)"
tests.hint: guard the index first; pop from a copy and return both values.
